test_TensorDict_from_tree: test the TensorDict.from_tree method that constructs a nested TensorDict from a plain dict of tensors
test_TensorDict_to_tree: test the TensorDict.to_tree method that converts a TensorDict back to a plain nested dict
test_TensorDict_indexing: test the TensorDict string and numeric indexing to access and assign tensor values by key or index
test_TensorDict_set: test the TensorDict.set method to assign values at a numeric index with strict or non-strict key matching
test_TensorDict_map: test the TensorDict.map and map_in_place methods to apply a lambda function across all leaf tensors
